content: Suena correcto, pero no es así. The dominance of fiscal themes over economic ones exists independently of who holds the position. headline: Fortaleciendo al MEF para transformar al Estado
content: - ‘‘EL PRESUPUESTO PÚBLICO DEBE ALINEARSE CON LA VISIÓN DE DESARROLLO DEL PAÍS.’’ xu.. Themes of productive development have the additional problem of lacking a roadmap, with impacts seen in medium and long term. Why does inertia persist? Every August ritual involves sector ministries negotiating budget cuts with the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF). They request substantial decreases while establishing negotiation baselines for increases based on past trends—a relatively consistent pattern offering little room for priority shifts or major reductions. Occasionally, inertia breaks—for instance, education saw a notable increase in 2014, infrastructure expanded during financial crises like those in 2009 and again anticipated in 2016. However, examples where sufficient information leads to strategic changes remain rare. Without adequate data, even well-intentioned policies result in fragmented outcomes rather than cohesive strategies aligned with national goals.

headline: Parlamento niega a Johnson tanto un Brexit duro como convocar elecciones
content: (Agencies) The British House of Commons approved legislation preventing Prime Minister Boris Johnson from exiting the EU without agreement—an attempt thwarted alongside his proposal for early elections before Octobers deadline. Following parliamentary agenda seizure by opponents, lawmakers voted overwhelmingly against both hard exit plans and immediate election calls until ensuring legislative passage blocking non-agreement exits passes through further stages including scrutiny by peers.

headline: John Kunze Mirar hacia los próximos 25 años de comercio electrónico
content: While we cannot foresee every innovation emerging next decade, several technologies promise transformative effects on daily commerce routines. These include enhanced connectivity via 5G enabling ubiquitous transactions, AI-driven personalized shopping experiences powered by vast datasets—and perhaps quantum computing—the rise of collaborative purchasing platforms facilitated by growing online communities, secure multi-factor digital identities simplifying user processes yet enhancing security protocols, along with green logistics transitioning mainstream practices away from wasteful packaging toward community-centric efficiency models—all collectively poised not merely altering purchase behaviors but ushering inclusive growth opportunities previously inaccessible segments now entering global economies.

El sector consumo también contribuirá a ese buen desempeño, impulsado por ganancias de las compañías In Retail e IFS. headline: ANTES DE INCREMENTARSE LA INCERTIDUMBRE POLÍTICA
content: Consumo no se frenará, pero sí inversión privada El 80% de la desaceleración que reportó la economía peruana en el primer semestre se explica por factores externos, principalmente por las tensiones comerciales entre Estados Unidos y China, estimó Daniel Velardia, economista jefe de Credicorp Capital.
